title: Frobenius-chain orthogonal Schauder basis in tame type-2/3 fields
statement: All fields below are fields [def-weil-field] with compatible nontrivial nonarchimedean real absolute values. For such a field $A$, write $A^\circ=\{x:|x|\le1\}$ for its valuation ring [def-trf-valuation-ring], $\widetilde A=A^\circ/\{x:|x|<1\}$ and $\Gamma_A=|A^\times|$. For a finite extension $B/A$ set $e(B/A)=[\Gamma_B:\Gamma_A]$, $f(B/A)=[\widetilde B:\widetilde A]$ and $d(B/A)=[B:A]/(e(B/A)f(B/A))$. Call it immediate if its value group and residue field equal those of $A$, unramified if $e=d=1$ and the residue extension is separable, and tame if $d=1$, its residue extension is separable and its ramification index is prime to the residue characteristic (with no index restriction in residue characteristic zero). A field extension is separable if every algebraic element has a minimal polynomial with distinct roots. Let $k$ be complete and algebraically closed, let $z\notin k$ lie in a complete extension, and let $K=k(z)^\wedge$ denote the closure of the subfield generated by $k$ and $z$. Assume either $\operatorname{trdeg}(\widetilde K/\widetilde k)=1$ and $\Gamma_K=\Gamma_k$, or $\widetilde K=\widetilde k$ and $\dim_{\mathbf Q}((\Gamma_K/\Gamma_k)\otimes_{\mathbf Z}\mathbf Q)=1$. Let $L/K$ be finite tame and suppose $p=\operatorname{char}(\widetilde k)>0$. There is a subset $U\subset L$ such that the sets $\{1\},U,U^p,U^{p^2},\ldots$ are pairwise disjoint and their union $\mathcal B$ is an orthogonal Schauder basis over $k$: every $x\in L$ has a unique expansion $x=\sum_{v\in\mathcal B}a_vv$, $a_v\in k$, whose net of finite partial sums converges to $x$ and for which $|x|=\max_v|a_vv|$ (the zero expansion has maximum zero). Moreover, for every finite $k$-linear combination $u$ of elements of $U$ and every $c\in L$, one has $|u+c^p|\ge|u|$. Here $U^{p^j}=\{u^{p^j}:u\in U\}$.
